summary: DeFi Technologies filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, announcing a shareholder call scheduled for August 14, 2026, to discuss Q2 2026 financial results, which will be released after market close on August 13, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings-related notification with no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, or strategic reviews. It merely provides logistics for the call and a general company overview. No deal terms, advisors, or premiums are mentioned. The event is a standard quarterly earnings communication, not a special situation requiring classification.
